children: Saudi Arabian building materials procurement platform BRKZ has raised $31 million funding from several investors including Aramco’s investment arm Wa’ed Ventures.
The fresh capital includes $13 million in Series B equity and $18 million in growth debt to be provided by Stride Ventures.
Wa’ed Ventures co-led the equity funding alongside 500 Global. Other equity investors include BECO Capital and Anb Seed Fund.
The new funds will support the development of advanced AI engines for pricing, quotations, payment-term decisions and fulfilment automation.
The company operates an AI-enabled procurement platform for construction and building materials, connecting contractors, factories and distributors with suppliers in Saudi Arabia and overseas.
(Writing by Cleofe Maceda; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Aramco’s Wa’ed Ventures backs $31mln funding for Saudi tech startup BRKZ
